title: Smoky Chipotle Meatloaf
description: This simple chipotle meatloaf is spicy and sweet with a smoky flavor. It's delicious right out of the oven, but the leftovers make incredible sandwiches.
ingredients: 2 cloves garlic, minced, or to taste
2 chipotle chilies in adobo sauce, minced, or to taste
2 tablespoons adobo sauce from chipotle peppers

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 9x5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray.

Whisk eggs in a large mixing bowl until smooth. Whisk in 1/3 cup barbecue sauce, garlic, chipotle chiles, adobo sauce, kosher salt, black pepper, celery salt, cumin, and Worcestershire sauce until evenly smooth. Mix in onion, oatmeal, and ground beef with your hands until evenly blended. Pack mixture into the prepared pan. Brush the top with 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce.
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).
